snippet.title: Announcement Trailer | Yandere Virus
snippet.description:
1–4 player co-op horror game. Yandere Virus
The demo will be available during Steam Next Fest on June 16.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4513060

An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. Play solo or with your friends to collect Platonic Pumpkins and save your precious friend infected by the terrifying Yandere Virus.
